steps.text: November 30th 8:00 P.M.
Dzwonek

steps.name: TV News
steps.text: The Leithanians had high praise for our city's prosperity, and the parties quick reached an agreement.

steps.name: TV News
steps.text: It is expected that regular trade will be established between Dzwonek and the Leithanian city of Graufield.

steps.name: TV News
steps.text: A Leithanien-inspired commercial district is also currently under construction on a new plate, the first phase of a project focusing on Leithanian art and music.

steps.name: TV News
steps.text: A spokesman for contractor Gale Industries touted the design of the new district, the brainchild of a world-famous architect, and promised that it will become a new landmark for Kazimierz.

steps.name: TV News
steps.text: The project is expected to be a massive boon for the city's tourism industry...

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: (Oops, cut this one a little thin...)

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: Honey?

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: Why don't you put that away? It's time to pick up our boy from school.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Can't he get home on his own?

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: I know he says you're nosy, but he doesn't mean it.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Nosy, huh? He's got a noble knight picking him up personally, the ungrateful brat... He was having so much fun playing with those peasants.

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: Just be patient, dear. You said it yourself: people will forget all about 'Plastic' Szewczyk before long, and then we'll be safe.

steps.name: TV News
steps.text: ...Next up, new Infected riots have been reported in the Old District. The National Council is currently investigating the incidents.

steps.name: TV News
steps.text: The police have acknowledged that Zeno Shelvin, the Infected ringleader who had previously turned himself in, has escaped custody. A number of officers have been suspended in connection with the escape.

steps.name: TV News
steps.text: A reward is being offered for information regarding...

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: You heard the news, right? You should go soon.

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: We came all the way to Dzwonek, even living among the common folk, but it looks like trouble is never far away.

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: To think I used to be worried about you getting hurt in the arena, and now I'm worried about our little boy making it home from school.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: You're overreacting. The press loves to exaggerate these things.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: If they were a real threat, we wouldn't be hearing about public investigations from the National Council.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: The only problem is the incompetent police who don't know how to track down the Infected without ID numbers. On their own, they're not much of a—

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Of course, the Infected make a good excuse to sell people insurance and protective gear. Especially after what happened at the Major.

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: Well... If it's so safe, why are you going out in full armor?

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: Alright, fine, then I won't worry, 'Sir Knight.'

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: This statue marks the edge of the Central District.

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: The outer plates are old, and there isn't much to see there.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: May I inquire as to the containers stacked up over there?

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: Ah... that's just an abandoned district.

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: There used to be a cargo passage leading down to the lower levels. After it was closed, old containers from decommissioned trucks began to pile up.

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: —O-Of course, we're currently working hard at giving Dzwonek a face-lift. Abandoned districts like these are all slated to be rebuilt very soon, and you won't see any trace of them by the next time you're here.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Is that so? I rather like how the colorful containers come together to form part of the cityscape.

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: Er, is that so? I-I suppose Leithanians do have an eye for art.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Heh, you flatter me.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: It's getting rather late, though. I shan't keep you.

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: It's no problem at all! It's been my pleasure to show you our city's nightscape.

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: But you also have the ribbon-cutting ceremony to attend tomorrow. Perhaps we should return to the hotel.

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: Incidentally, if you enjoy music, I also have a few best-selling albums from Dzwonek here. Would you like to have a listen to them in your room?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Ah, that's very kind of you, but I've already picked the pieces I wish to enjoy tonight. I hope I'm causing no offense?

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: Er, no, of course not.

steps.name: Dzwonek Rep
steps.text: Then I will take my leave here. Good night, and we will be back to pick you up tomorrow.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: I've asked around, sir.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: But are you really sure you want to go at this hour?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Are we being watched?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Not right now, as far as I can tell.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Then let's. I'd prefer to end this trip on a high note.

steps.name: Rowdy Stowaway
steps.text: How do you feel?

steps.name: Injured Infected Knight
steps.text: How do you think I feel? Does my leg look like it's getting better?

steps.name: Rowdy Stowaway
steps.text: This was from a legit pharmacy, and it cost a pretty penny. It's not working?

steps.name: Injured Infected Knight
steps.text: Wouldn't be the first time stuff from legit sources didn't work.

steps.name: Rowdy Stowaway
steps.text: What happens to the plan if you can't walk?

steps.name: Injured Infected Knight
steps.text: Shh...

steps.name: Injured Infected Knight
steps.text: Someone's coming.

steps.name: Rowdy Stowaway
steps.text: Ahem. Er, may I help you, sir?

steps.name: Rowdy Stowaway
steps.text: We have nothing to do with any attacks, and we don't know that man you're with.

steps.name: Rowdy Stowaway
steps.text: The cops have been here a few times already. Everyone checked out clean.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...I'm looking for the Weaver.

steps.name: Rowdy Stowaway
steps.text: Oh, you're friends with them? Didn't look like it.

steps.name: Rowdy Stowaway
steps.text: Go around behind that dark-red container. You'll find an empty tailor shop with a hidden door in the back, leading to a long alley. Ask around when you reach their warehouse.

steps.name: Rowdy Stowaway
steps.text: Not even a word of thanks?

steps.name: Injured Infected Knight
steps.text: What'd you expect from a noble?

steps.name: Injured Infected Knight
steps.text: Back to the plan. You got word from the boss?

steps.name: Rowdy Stowaway
steps.text: Yeah, it's urgent, and it's happening tonight. Getting cold feet?

steps.name: Injured Infected Knight
steps.text: A little, but it's like fighting gloompincers—there's no turning back.

steps.name: Injured Infected Knight
steps.text: ...It'll be worth it even if just to make the people in high places sweat a little.

steps.name: Serious Corporate Employee
steps.text: I heard they're finally cleaning up that junk across the street, and expanding the commercial district towards the east.

steps.name: Tired Corporate Employee
steps.text: Finally.

steps.name: Serious Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yeah, they should've blown it up ages ago. We've got kids from nearby schools playing hide-and-seek in it, and that's an accident waiting to happen.

steps.name: Serious Corporate Employee
steps.text: Who knows how filthy it is in all those containers and shacks? Homeless, Infected...

steps.name: Serious Corporate Employee
steps.text: Seriously, why do they even want to live in slums like that? Life would be so much better if they left for one of the villages in the barrenlands.

steps.name: Serious Corporate Employee
steps.text: The light's green. Let's go—
A loud noise, and the grey skies of the abandoned district are lit up by flames.

steps.name: Serious Corporate Employee
steps.text: Wh-What was that? Something exploded?

steps.name: Serious Corporate Employee
steps.text: Run!

steps.name: Serious Corporate Employee
steps.text: Why are you just standing there like that? Get out of the way!

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: ...Did I hear you say that kids from nearby schools play in the abandoned district?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Aloisia!

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Are you okay, sir?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: I'm sorry, I didn't realize...

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Don't blame yourself. I'm not hurt, and I was the one who insisted on coming to the slums.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: But it looks like there's a wall of rubble between us.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: I'll find another path and meet up with you, sir.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: The explosion was rather near our position, however.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Please be careful, as this could potentially be a targeted attack.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: ...Alright, I'll wait here.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: I hear voices...

steps.name: Sobbing Child
steps.text: It hurts... ow...

steps.name: Anxious Child
steps.text: Come on, get this sheet of metal off him! He's bleeding!

steps.name: Nervous Child
steps.text: I'm trying, I'm trying... it's so dark, I can't see...

steps.name: Nervous Child
steps.text: What if I make a mistake and open up the wound...

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: (Even if people are watching... I should be able to use Originium Arts to move some of the stones and metal for them without drawing attention.)

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: (Was this really targeted at me though? My visit to the abandoned district wasn't on the itinerary.)

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: (And Aloisia would have noticed if someone was tailing me.)

steps.name: Sobbing Child
steps.text: It's dark... I wanna go home...

steps.name: Sobbing Child
steps.text: You're not gonna leave me, right...?

steps.name: Anxious Child
steps.text: Hold on, let's grab a rock... Hey, is someone coming?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: (A businessman? Government official?)

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: (No, it's the man I encountered beneath the statue yesterday... with an Infected by his side.)

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: (He's deeply prejudiced against Leithanien, and the Infected with him doesn't exactly seem like the amicable sort. I should stay out of sight.)

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Did you see an Infected with a white scar on his arm?

steps.name: Nervous Child
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Anxious Child
steps.text: I don't care who you are, we're not scared of you...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...What's going on here?

steps.name: Nervous Child
steps.text: C-Could you help get our friend out? His leg got caught on a sharp piece of metal, and it bleeds if he tries to move.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: (Did he just glance at me?)

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: If only I had my tools... If this was one of our workers, we'd have just dragged him out.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...I don't have any better ideas.

steps.name: Sobbing Child
steps.text: Waaaaaaahhhhh!

steps.name: Nervous Child
steps.text: I-It's bleeding... the wound looks scary...

steps.name: Anxious Child
steps.text: Don't cry, I'll tie it up with some clothes.

steps.name: Anxious Child
steps.text: And don't worry, my dad used to get hurt all the time. He says a couple of days is all it takes to get better.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Just a flesh wound.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Get it treated at a hospital.

steps.name: Nervous Child
steps.text: Alright... come on, take my shoulder.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Leithanian.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: How long do you plan on watching from there?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: This abandoned district is even worse than the Infected district in the Grand Knight Territory... When I catch that brat, he's getting a stern lesson on where is and is not appropriate for a noble to visit.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: ...Dammit, where did he go?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Hey, did you see any kids playing around here?

steps.name: Panicked Refugee
steps.text: Whose kid? It's such a big place, I can't possibly remember the face of every kid...

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Then cut the crap.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Why are you trying to run? There's nowhere else for you people to go in this city anyway.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Look, I'll pay you to go back and rescue any children you see.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: And if you run into anyone else, you can tell them too. That I'll pay for each child that they bring back to me.

steps.name: Panicked Refugee
steps.text: Wh-Who are you? This isn't some kind of sick joke, is it?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Here's the cash. You can choose whether you want it or not.

steps.name: Panicked Refugee
steps.text: T-This is...?! Yes, sir, whatever you say, sir!
Sending people into a fire, eh? Must be nice having money to burn.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: Mr. 'Plastic' Szewczyk.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: Don't worry, I know a lot of things, and you're not one of the important ones.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: If you're not here to help, then don't waste my time.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: Let me put it this way... obsolete goods like you are worth less than nothing. It takes a bigger target to start this fire.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: What do you mean? Who caused the explosion?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Who dares harm my son?

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: No need to shout, you don't scare me.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: But I do enjoy watching rich folks like you flee for your lives, losing whatever you hold dearest.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: If you think you can get under my nerves with this crap, then you're wasting your time and mine.

spans.text: If you think you can get under my nerves with this crap, then you're wasting your time

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: Look. That billboard is about to fall.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: How many evacuees will it kill, and will your son be among them? Wanna bet?
An arrow whistles past him before he can finish his sentence.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Zero, and no.
The billboard is now pinned to a wall by the arrow.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Now, let's talk business.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: I could use a guide who knows the lay of the land here.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: You want to go in yourself?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: I'm finding my son and getting him out of here. Now get moving, unless you'd like to be pinned to a wall too?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: I must warn you that any threat made upon my life will result in a diplomatic incident between Kazimierz and Leithanien.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Diplomatic incident? You'd better explain why you're here, first. Since when were our slums considered a tourist attraction?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I don't recall threatening you either. All I did was tell you to come with us.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: You're hostile towards me... towards Leithanien.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Do you really think your deceitful words and suspicious activities truly represent all of Leithanien?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Perhaps we've misunderstood each other. Someone else is responsible for the explosion.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: But I will not let my guard down against you. My hand is on my wand.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Suit yourself.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: S-Sir, someone's calling for help over there. Can you hear it?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Should we help or... well, actually, I was wondering, aren't you afraid of being arrested for being with me like this?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: There's no reason for them to do that.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: And you're not worried about getting infected?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Let's go.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: If you here to help these people, I'm more than willing to demonstrate my good faith.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Of standing around and doing nothing?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: ...I regret not using my Originium Arts to aid the child, out of concern for my own safety.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Visitor from Leithanien... why did you come here?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: ...Please don't doubt my good faith.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: To be honest, I came here because I envy the cities of Kazimierz.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...The modern Kazimierz?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Yes, where nobles, entrepreneurs, and commoners can all walk on the same street without anyone having to give way to one another.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Where the goods in the shops are made for everyone, whether they can use Originium Arts or not, whether they appreciate music or not.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Here, people can pursue any lifestyle they want, as long as they have money, and there is plenty of opportunity for that.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: I only wish the people in my fief had the same energy, and that more of them could live better lives...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Opportunity? A better life? Don't tell me someone of your position and experience could be blinded by superficial appearances?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Of course I understand that I'm only being shown the best side. I've seen more than enough gold and jewels in the brief time that I've been here.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Which is exactly why I wanted to come to where the poor live, to see the people whom your rules have cast aside.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Thus, I will learn from them and improve upon the system.

steps.name: Faint Cry for Help
steps.text: No, I don't want to die! I can't walk yet... please...

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: A secondary explosion...

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: It must be due to the high temperatures.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: It's dangerous here... Are we really going to look for the person you mentioned? What if they've already fled?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: I can't have you getting hurt helping me.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...I have my own business here.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: If you truly are acting in good faith, Leithanian, you will open a path here.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: There may yet be hope, if we head there immediately.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: The voice came from behind the wall.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: The door's warped... I'll try to clear a way with my Arts.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: ...It'll take some time though.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Go ahead. If I'd meant to harm you, I would've done so by now.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Very well...

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: *cough*... The fire's spreading.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: I was caught in a fire once, many years ago.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Someone tried to set the count's tower ablaze, the day the Witch King's light faded from Leithanien.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: The arsonist was never found. Perhaps many who had been slaves to fear threw kindling upon the flames all at once, the moment they could breathe again.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: The fire itself didn't cause too much damage. My father's casters quickly brought it under control.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Treasures could be replaced, as could servants.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: But I couldn't help but think... that the fact that I continue to live in comfort and luxury is perhaps the reason they lit that fire.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: And what of you? Why do you stand in the flames with no fear on your face? Even if you deny it, you look like one who has seen the burning fires of war up close.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: —Done.
The voice becomes increasingly discernable as the dust clears.

The faint light of Originium Arts illuminates a room that looks like it has been turned over. Furniture is scattered across the ground, and any signs of life are long gone from the body buried beneath the rubble.
The only sound comes from a radio on the ground.

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: Here are the assignments for squads around Dzwonek for the new equipment test.

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: Intel obtained from the captured Leithanian spy indicates that Leithanien has developed multiple Arts Units designed to penetrate Kazimierz knight armor.

steps.name: Radio
steps.text: In preparation for the war with Leithanien—
A hand snatches up the radio and smashes it on the ground.
The Leithanian noble grows pale as he processes what he just heard.
Dzwonek, an important military outpost, still has 'the bones of sentry towers and turrets hidden in the corners.'
This was what he told the Kazimierz knight standing before him, the day before.
The great steel eye remains focused on Leithanien, on him.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: I... I didn't hear anything...

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: I don't know...
His eyes land on the caster rapidly approaching his counterpart from behind.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Aloisia! Kill him!

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: We'll be trapped by the fire if you don't turn back.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: You've rescued everyone who could be rescued along the way. Doesn't look like anyone else is breathing down here.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: Neither of us found what we were looking for, but... one less piece of intel doesn't make a huge difference.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: As for you, I'm sure you have dozens of sons waiting for you on the main street by now.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Someone's fighting? Here?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Let go of my wand, Infected!

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: You'd better be prepared to get Infected blood on you, if you want to harm my savior.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Out of the way, Zeno.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Huh?
An arrow whistles past the young Infected's cheek, just as he is pushed away.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Blasted Infected! I remember your face! You're the culprit behind the riots!

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: And you, Młynar Nearl! I knew someone was backing them.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: What are you plotting? What are you doing here? House Nearl just can't help but side with the Infected, can it?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Who are you to question House Nearl—

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Why are you dragging us into trouble, this far away from the Grand Knight Territory?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Let's go, Aloisia!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...You let the Leithanians get away.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Answer me! What are you planning? Where's my son?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Enough. Do you really believe everything the press reports? Don't tell me you're still as foolish as the day you first lost in that ridiculous competition, and drowned yourself in wine.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...I saw a boy with purple hair.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: If he has the slightest sense of responsibility, he'll have accompanied his friend to the hospital.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Alright, I'll believe you for now.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: But there will be hell to pay if he's not there.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: And you, Weaver.

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: Oh, you're...

steps.name: Sinister Refugee
steps.text: You're looking for them?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: We want to talk to the bounty hunters. Now.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: This should be far enough... He didn't come after us. He must have been delayed.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: How are your injuries, Aloisia?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Just a scratch I took on the counter.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: You won't be doing anything so dangerous when we're back in Leithanien. You'll have plenty of time to recover.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Yes, sir. I apologize.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Anybody watching us?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: No, sir.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: The reporters at the exit to the street are busy interviewing someone. They won't be paying attention.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Then let's go.

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: We must leave Kazimierz, now.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: What about tomorrow's ceremony?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: ...It's a shame.

steps.name: Excited Reporter
steps.text: You saved the lives of 22 children! What is your name and occupation? Are you an experienced rescuer?

steps.name: Excited Reporter
steps.text: How many of the children do you know? What made you decide to help so many people whom you've never met?

steps.name: Sentimental Reporter
steps.text: Where did you find them? We saw an injured child being sent to the hospital. What did you feel as you rescued him?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Out of the way, out of the way.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: I need to find my son.

steps.name: Curious Reporter
steps.text: Your outfit is similar to the so-called 'Plastic Knight,' who hasn't been seen for a while. Are you a fan of his? Did he inspire you to this valorous deed?

steps.name: Independent Knight Szewczyk
steps.text: Plastic armor's good enough. I'm an archer, and I don't let the opponent get near me.

steps.name: Independent Knight Szewczyk
steps.text: It may have been fun and games, but it's also true that nobody's come close to matching me.

steps.name: Independent Knight Szewczyk
steps.text: And think about it: there will be no ads printed on this armor.

steps.name: Independent Knight Szewczyk
steps.text: When I'm interviewed as the winner, I'll let the world know that I made it myself.

steps.name: Independent Knight Szewczyk
steps.text: It'll be a slap in the face for those big companies, for taking away our livelihoods with inferior mass-produced goods.

steps.name: Independent Knight Szewczyk
steps.text: Don't cry, I'll be fine. I'll yield if things aren't looking good, and I'll be back with you safe and sound.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: ...It's too late for an interview.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Like I said, I'm picking up my son.

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: One informant was 'unfortunately' lost in the accident, just as planned. No other casualties.

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Target has returned to his hotel, accompanied by his bodyguard.

steps.name: Czcibor
steps.text: That's unfortunate. It would have given us an edge at the negotiation table if he'd gone off on his own and gotten into an accident at the abandoned district.

steps.name: Czcibor
steps.text: But impromptu plans rarely go smoothly.

steps.name: Czcibor
steps.text: What about Nearl?

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Unknown.

steps.name: Czcibor
steps.text: ...He must have left with someone familiar with the secret passages.

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Also, a letter just arrived.

steps.name: Czcibor
steps.text: At this hour?

steps.name: Campaign Knight
steps.text: Yes, sir. For your eyes only.

steps.name: Czcibor
steps.text: From the bounty hunters... alright, back to your station.

steps.name: Czcibor
steps.text: You know I keep my promises, Toland.
A certain someone says he recently dreamt of us? Come on, you must be so worried that you can't sleep.
I know what you're planning, Czcibor, and I suggest you think twice.
You were always the calmest and most rational of us.
I didn't use force or cause any trouble. All that happened is that someone sent us records of Gale Industries and your knightclub working with each other.

steps.name: Czcibor
steps.text: Ha. As if there were another way.

steps.name: TV News
steps.text: A man who did not wish to be named rescued more than 20 children from the fire in the abandoned district.

steps.name: TV News
steps.text: Although he declined to talk about his experience and avoided cameras, witnesses report that his cloak was covered in ashes.

steps.name: Loud Boy
steps.text: You were really cool, Dad.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Ha. Now you think so?

steps.name: Loud Boy
steps.text: I want to be a knight too.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Loud Boy
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Loud Boy
steps.text: I want to be able to save people, just like you.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: That's not how it happened.

steps.name: Loud Boy
steps.text: You always spend the whole day at home working on this stuff. Why not make me a suit of plastic armor too?

steps.name: Loud Boy
steps.text: Mom said we didn't use to have so much money. You used to make your own equipment because you had no sponsors.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: She told you all that?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Never mind. Starting tomorrow, you don't need to go to school. In fact, you're not allowed to go out at all until I say it's okay.

steps.name: Loud Boy
steps.text: Huh? But I need to visit my friend at the hospital.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: No. Haven't you learned your lesson? Do you want to sleep in a hospital bed too?

steps.name: Loud Boy
steps.text: I'm not scared! Knights aren't scared of things like that!

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Like I said... forget about becoming a knight. Knights can't protect people like you think.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: The bigger the dream, the bigger the disappointment.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Now get to bed.
